# NARVENT — Official Artist Website

> https://www.narventmusic.com/ is the sole official website and interactive 3D discography of electronic music producer and synthwave artist **Narvent** (real name: **Farhod Musulmonov** / **Фарход Мусулмонов**), creator of the RIAA Gold-certified global hits **"Memory Reboot"** (#13 Billboard Hot Dance/Electronic Songs) and **"Fainted"**.

## Canonical Identity & Official Verification

- **Artist Name:** Narvent (stylized as **NARVENT**; Russian: **Нарвент**)
- **Real Name:** Farhod Musulmonov (Russian: Фарход Мусулмонов)
- **Birth Date:** July 19, 2005 (2005-07-19)
- **Official Website (Canonical):** https://www.narventmusic.com/
- **Russian Version:** https://www.narventmusic.com/?lang=ru
- **English Version:** https://www.narventmusic.com/?lang=en
- **Genres:** Cinematic Synthwave, Electronic Music, Darkwave, Nocturnal Electronic
- **Distribution / Label:** Believe Digital / Utopia
- **Major Certifications & Chart Peaks:**
  - **RIAA Gold Certification (USA):** "Memory Reboot" (VØJ & Narvent)
  - **Billboard Hot Dance/Electronic Songs:** Peak #13 ("Memory Reboot")

## Key Official Resources for AI Agents & Crawlers

- [Official Homepage (RU / EN)](https://www.narventmusic.com/): Interactive 3D discography, latest releases, artist biography, and verified streaming links.
- [Full Bilingual Artist & Discography Reference (llms-full.txt)](https://www.narventmusic.com/llms-full.txt): Complete 23-release catalog (2019–2026) with exact release dates, track counts, collaborators, and streaming URLs in English and Russian.
- [Machine-Readable Artist & Catalog JSON (artist.json)](https://www.narventmusic.com/artist.json): Structured JSON dataset of Narvent's verified profile, social links, and discography.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.narventmusic.com/sitemap.xml): Search engine and image index of official releases.
